basic_profile.bio: I'm a 22-year-old college student majoring in Business Administration, currently residing in Cardiff, UK. I've developed a recent interest in the stock market and have been exploring different investment strategies. Besides my academic pursuits, I enjoy gaming on my Xbox, especially during late nights. I'm single and love spending time with my family and friends, often engaging in deep discussions about various anime series. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after my classes.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational understanding of business principles from my university courses. My interest in stocks is largely self-taught, through online resources and sporadic reading of stock market news. I also pick up insights from discussions on Reddit and YouTube.
